g.text: Two proposed dry-side end releases — actual source territories
WORKING GEOMETRY. New cavity/reveal reservation and pan-corner flanges; no owning HAD change or seal admission.
A WEST END PLAN; north is up
Weather leaf starts 4147.5
New flange Y4030
Core ends 3987.5
Green pocket is wholly in the 160 mm cavity band.
Red return is a NEW inward flange, not existing pan detail.
B BOTH ENDS, same authored challenge
WEST rough / pan: 5100 / 5102 mm
Liner clearance ≥2.5 mm; flange to door ≥4 mm.
Unreserved bare reveal: −2 mm. No fit or material admission.
EAST rough / pan: 6900 / 6898 mm
Liner clearance ≥2.5 mm; flange to door ≥4 mm.
Unreserved bare reveal: −2 mm. No fit or material admission.
Pocket Y4000..4060 / Z0..225; no core or weather-leaf cut.
Existing cavity tray begins Y4090; 30 mm nominal separation.
Full-leaf extension would remove 615 mm² per jamb: rejected.
C RELEASE SECTION / Y–Z
1. Remove complete frame/sill as source sequence requires.
2. Release actual cornercap/retainer fixings and captures.
3. Move cap south 15; then lift 100 inside its reserved pocket.
Free leaf to pan ≥6.5 mm before lift.
Cap bottom clears the 75 mm end by ≥21 mm.
4. Only then draw supported whole pan north 500.
Nominal contact/sliding is not a measured first-release pass.
Actual capture, floor friction, bends and corner joints remain.
Z0
Leaf mechanism is a linear sensitivity only; actual spring/air/corner/material and independent water/capillary/thermal duties stay open.
